prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm golden-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, soft and heavy and slack; a gigantic bust resting on the top fold, her waist lost beneath the folds, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, blunt bob natural black hair — wearing a skin-tight micro one-shoulder school uniform set, a cropped top of ultra-thin matte deep navy scuba crepe held by a single wide strap over her left shoulder with a gold stripe and a small gold crest on the strap, her right shoulder and right arm bare, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the scuba crepe fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and a micro pleated skirt of the same scuba crepe with a thin white stripe along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin scuba crepe molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the single wide strap with its gold stripe and crest and the long bare line of her right shoulder and arm, a smooth pebbled crepe texture and fine stretch lines. Pose: reclining on her side on a giant sunflower petal propped on one elbow, her legs stretched out long and crossed at the ankles, the other hand resting on her hip, chin lifted, looking at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme USSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy navy leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in navy lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: mirror-bright glass skin dripping with wet liquid shine, blinding liquid highlighter across the cheekbones, nose bridge, forehead and chin, a flushed dewy blush, mirror-gloss lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: a sunny summer garden in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic yellow sunflower with petals as long as her whole body fills the frame, a giant fuzzy bee hovering beside it, giant green leaves with veins like roads, a softly blurred garden of flowers far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall sitting on a giant sunflower petal with the giant flowers rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by bright warm sunlight with soft shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous sunflower, bee and leaves around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
